title: [KBM] New editor: suspend the KBM engine while the remap dialog is open

status.label: Manual review completion required
status.detail: Eight actual automated requests are exhausted. The final substantive result published three concerns; all were assessed, answered and resolved, with thirteen threads and zero unresolved. Current single-modal callers and synchronous event creation refute the hypothetical in-process nesting and event-opening timing claims. Cross-process ownership and a retained custom-startup correction remain independently unverified. The final review was nonzero, and no validated author-facing patch or approval is available.

next_action: Complete human correctness review at revision ed71df92737593dc5c5d73170b7d48d649360b98. Trace EngineSuspendHelper.Acquire and Release, MainPage dialog acquisition/finally cleanup, and App/MainWindow teardown. Determine whether independent Settings editor processes can own the shared named suspension event concurrently and whether one process can reset it while another still requires suspension; do not infer this from unsupported in-process nesting. Assess any single-instance correction against existing launch and native-editor mutex semantics. Verify startup before Application.Start, compilation-symbol preservation, duplicate and abandoned-owner handling, normal mutex release and cleanup. Build the exact upstream editor/test chain and each retained correction separately. Where behavior needs physical remapped input or concurrent interactive launches, verify in a disposable Windows session with dedicated input and restore keys, processes and profile afterward. Refresh literal patch materialization to include all final startup corrections before proposing an apply-ready patch. Existing author answers already cover the prior coverage request; do not demand that answer again. Record a revision-pinned disposition without a ninth automated request.
